media.title: Pommersche Straße 3, Berlin-Wilmersdorf — aerial context, 1928
media.description: Official 1928 aerial mosaic showing the eastern end of Pommersche Straße at Sächsische Straße in Berlin-Wilmersdorf. Kaper’s 1932 address book entry gives Pommersche Straße 3; the historical parcel is identified from the later official plan for Sächsische Straße 48–49 / Pommersche Straße 3–4.
media.altText: Black-and-white aerial photograph from 1928 showing Pommersche Straße running diagonally toward its junction with Sächsische Straße in Berlin-Wilmersdorf.
media.publicCaption: The eastern end of Pommersche Straße at Sächsische Straße, Berlin-Wilmersdorf, in 1928. Kaper was listed at Pommersche Straße 3 in the 1932 Berlin address book; the former corner parcel is located approximately.

places.publicNote: Documented Berlin residence: the Berliner Adreßbuch 1932 lists B. Kaper, composer, at Pommersche Straße 3 in Wilmersdorf. A later official planning record identifies the historical corner parcel as Sächsische Straße 48–49 / Pommersche Straße 3–4. Numbers 3–4 are absent from the present official address register, so the marker locates the historical corner parcel approximately rather than a surviving entrance.
